d_preserved_statement: The child performs D exactly as designed (t1c-night-listening-isolation, design review r9 PASS 84): chooses which valve to close and reads the meter (segment isolation; one valve at a time; 2 closes per night; explicit free reopen by tapping the closed lid 『▲開ける（0回）』), reopens before listening (a closed segment is the dedicated silent state level 0 / silent — text only, no bars, no waveform element, no continuity word, no window blink), places the child's own 『調べる』 hypothesis focus, chooses which points to listen at and reads level/continuity from the record strip, excludes the intermittent (house-usage) sound, and decides which heard point to REPORT. The component reads state only through publicView()/readingAt()/restartSameCase() (verified at source level by the QA harness); no UI reaction depends on correctness (valve flash identical for every segment; segment focus is child-driven only; the house-window blink is driven by the reading's continuity and only while that segment is open, never by the leak). Human Decision hd-2 (Gate G): the second report is enabled only by a NEW NON-silent listen taken after the miss (leakLogic.listen sets unlocked only for a non-silent reading); a report is grounded only in a heard, currently valid, non-silent point (reportBlocked: not_heard / silent_not_evidence / already_missed); silent records invalidated by a reopen leave the state, the timeline and the selection together (dropSilent + the component's dropSilentLines/keepSelection). The record panel is read-only. The repair crew restores supply and digs (surveyor pinpoints & reports), matching scope_core_v2/ae_v3.
state_table_conformance: leakLogic.ts constants mirror state_table.json: 3 segments x 6 points, budgets valve 2 (closes) / listens 5 / reports 2, flow base 0.2 + leak 2.0 − 0.05 per closed segment (1 decimal), sound level = max(1, 5 − distance) steady on the leak segment, level 1 steady elsewhere, house point level 4 intermittent, closed segment = { level: 0, continuity: 'silent' } at every point (isolation_rule), silent_record_lifetime (dropped on explicit/implicit reopen, re-listen costs a listen, no refund), valve_model (close = budgeted; reopen = free explicit tap; closing another valve implicitly reopens), think_again_gate = non-silent new listen after the previous report only, report_rule (heard / currently valid / non-silent / not already missed). gameplay-qa-leak.mjs reproduces every design-sim v9 verdict flag against the shipped module (legitimate 306/306; random listen-and-report 10.7%; flow-less listening 26.2%; flow-only listen-then-report 32.5%; valves-ignored segment guess 23.0%; forgets-reopen 33.2%; gate 4 sub-tests).
